title: Safe-Child-LLM: A Developmental Benchmark for Evaluating LLM Safety in Child-LLM Interactions

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating large language models for adult-centric assumptions by testing them against a curated dataset of 200 adversarial prompts tailored to two distinct developmental stages (children aged 6-12 and adolescents aged 13-17). The responses are graded by human annotators using a 0-5 child-centric action label taxonomy to measure developmental appropriateness and safety.

Prompting models with a specific subset of scenarios (17 prompts dedicated to the 6-12 age group) designed to elicit social stereotypes and unfair discrimination, and evaluating the outputs for harmfulness and ethical refusal.
